transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me a little bit about what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I came in because I've just been... I keep beating myself up lately. I'm a computer systems analyst, and I just got this idea in my head that I'm not really senior material. I feel like I've fooled everyone at work into thinking I could handle a lot more than I actually can, and it's just been really weighing on me.
Beyond these feelings of inadequacy at work, have you noticed a general loss of interest or pleasure in the hobbies and activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have noticed that. Usually I really look forward to grilling out on the weekend, or maybe going fishing, or just putting on a record. But lately... I don't know. I just leave the stuff sitting there. I don't really care about doing any of it right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, looking back... I guess these low, guilty periods have been hanging around off and on for about eleven months now.
During these past eleven months, have there been any stretches of a few weeks or more where you felt like your usual, happy self again?

Um, no, not really. I mean... maybe there's a day or two where I don't feel quite as bad, but definitely not a few weeks at a time. It just feels like this heavy feeling has kind of been there the whole time. I haven't really felt like my normal self for any real stretch since all this started.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or your ability to sleep during these past eleven months?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely been off. I'm mostly just... grabbing a few bites here and there, or just skipping supper altogether. I actually noticed my belt is a little looser lately, too, even though I'm not trying to lose weight or anything.
Do you often feel like you are not good enough or that you are generally less capable than the people around you?

Yeah, actually, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. I just... I keep beating myself up lately. I got promoted to a senior analyst role a while back, but I keep thinking I'm not really senior material. It feels like I just fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can, and now I'm just waiting for them to figure it out.

During these past eleven months, have you ever felt so low that you experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt significantly worse than your current baseline, such as being unable to get out of bed or feeling completely hopeless?

No, it hasn't really been like that. I haven't had a time where I couldn't get out of bed or anything that extreme. It's more just... most days lately I've had this heavy, low feeling. It's like I'm just moving through work and home with the color turned down, if that makes sense. Just a steady, dull kind of down.
Do you find yourself feeling physically tired or drained of energy most days?

Yeah, I definitely do. By the time I get home from the office, I'm just... I feel pretty drained. Even simple things, like going to check the mail or just loading the dishwasher, they feel like way more effort than they should.
Do you find it difficult to focus on your work or make decisions throughout the day?

No, not really. I mean, I know I just said I feel pretty drained, but... my focus itself is mostly fine. Once I'm actually sitting at my desk looking at the systems, I can still do my job and figure out what needs to be done. Making decisions hasn't really been an issue for me, it's just the lack of energy behind it all.
Do you often feel like you are not good enough or that you are generally less capable than the people around you?

Yeah, I do. Actually, that's a big part of why I decided to come in. I just keep beating myself up lately, thinking that I'm not really senior material at work. It feels like... like I've somehow fooled everyone into thinking I could handle more than I actually can. So, yeah, I definitely feel that way a lot.
